Container.Name: CamStack-Agent
Container.Overview: A CamStack Agent is a worker node. It joins a CamStack hub and runs the heavy work on this machine instead: ML detection, hardware decode/encode, the WebRTC and RTSP broker, and recording. This is not a standalone install — run the CamStack hub first, then point this at it. Until a hub is set the agent serves a status dashboard on port 4444 where you can configure the connection. The app version is managed by the hub; only the boot loader comes from this image.
Container.Requires: A running CamStack hub on the same network — set its address below.

Config.Name: Status dashboard (HTTP)
Config.Description: Agent status dashboard: hub connection, cameras handled here, logs and metrics. Also where you set the hub address in discovery mode.

Config.Name: Cluster transport (TCP)
Config.Description: Moleculer cluster transport between the hub and remote agents. Needed only for a multi-machine cluster.

Config.Name: Cluster discovery (UDP)
Config.Description: Moleculer same-subnet auto-discovery. Not needed when the hub address is set explicitly.

Config.Name: RTSP restream
Config.Description: RTSP restream served on demand by the stream broker.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Installed addons, ML models, native dependencies, logs and this agent's identity. Use a different folder from the hub. Safe to wipe — it re-seeds from the hub on the next boot.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: config.yaml. The image declares /config as a volume, so leaving it unmapped makes Docker create a fresh anonymous volume on every re-create. Map it even though an agent keeps little here.

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: The image declares /backups as a volume. An agent rarely runs backup destinations, but map it (or Docker makes a fresh anonymous volume on every re-create). Paired with CAMSTACK_BACKUP_ROOT.

Config.Name: Recordings
Config.Description: Recordings and event media for cameras assigned to this agent. Point at a roomy share. Paired with CAMSTACK_MEDIA_ROOT below.

Config.Name: Coral USB (whole USB bus)
Config.Description: Coral USB Edge TPU. The whole bus is mapped, not one device node, because the accelerator re-enumerates from 1a6e:089a to 18d1:9302 when libedgetpu initialises. Paired with the --device-cgroup-rule flag. Remove if you have no Coral.

Config.Name: Intel/AMD GPU
Config.Description: Hardware video decode/encode (VAAPI/QSV) and OpenVINO GPU inference. Remove this if the machine has no integrated GPU — software decode costs roughly 60% of a CPU for a handful of 4K HEVC cameras.

Config.Name: Intel NPU
Config.Description: Intel NPU (OpenVINO) for ML inference. Remove if the machine has no NPU. The entrypoint chowns the device nodes to the container user on boot.

Config.Name: Node role
Config.Description: hub | agent. One image serves both; this selects the role at boot. Leave it as agent here.

Config.Name: Hub address
Config.Description: IP or hostname of the hub to join, e.g. 192.168.x.x. Leave blank to boot into discovery mode and set it from the dashboard on port 4444.

Config.Name: Hub URL
Config.Description: Full hub base URL, e.g. https://192.168.x.x:4443. Leave blank to derive it from the hub address above; set it only when the hub is on a non-default port or behind a proxy.

Config.Name: Node ID
Config.Description: Stable cluster identifier for this agent, e.g. gpu-box. Defaults to the container hostname. Must be unique across the cluster and must not change once the hub knows it.

Config.Name: Display name
Config.Description: How this agent is labelled in the topology view. Defaults to the node ID.

Config.Name: Cluster secret
Config.Description: Shared secret. If the hub is configured with one, this must match exactly or the hub rejects the registration. Leave blank if the hub has none.

Config.Name: Media root
Config.Description: Container path all media is written under. Must match the Recordings path above.

Config.Name: Cluster: advertise hostname
Config.Description: Must stay false for a multi-machine cluster so nodes advertise their IP rather than a container hostname no other host can resolve.

Config.Name: Cluster: event fanout
Config.Description: Inter-node event delivery mode: filter | shadow | broadcast.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: trace | debug | info | warn | error.
